title: Knight Delivers Mate
setup: Black's king stands on d7 walled in by its own pawns on c7 and e7, and your b-pawn is ready to arrive.
hint: A new queen on b8 would not even give check. Ask which promotion touches d7 from that square at all.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{b8=N#}} checks from b8, and the king has no square: c6 is covered by the knight, d6 by the e5-pawn, e6 by the f5-pawn, and c8, d8 and e8 by the rook on h8. c7 and e7 are its own pawns. A queen there would give no check at all.
